questions.q: In which year did Paraguay become independent?
questions.why: It was declared on 14–15 May.

questions.q: Which 1864–70 war devastated Paraguay?
questions.a: Paraguayan War (War of the Triple Alliance)
questions.why: It fought Brazil, Argentina and Uruguay.

questions.q: Which 1932–35 war did Paraguay win against Bolivia?
questions.why: It won much of the Chaco region.

questions.q: Which dictator ruled Paraguay from 1954 to 1989?
questions.why: His rule was one of the longest in Latin America.

questions.q: Which leader died in the final battle of the Paraguayan War in 1870?
questions.why: Paraguay lost much of its population.

questions.q: Which national hero of the Chaco War led its armies?
questions.why: He later became President.

questions.q: Which 1989 coup ended Stroessner's rule?
questions.why: Rodríguez then became President.

questions.q: Which German-founded farming communities are in the Chaco?
questions.why: Filadelfia is a main town.

questions.q: What is the capital of Paraguay?
questions.why: It is one of South America's oldest cities.

questions.q: Which Jesuit mission ruins are a UNESCO site?
questions.a: La Santísima Trinidad de Paraná and Jesús de Tavarangue
questions.why: They date from the 1700s.

questions.q: Which river flows past Asunción?
questions.why: It gives the country its name.

questions.q: Which landlocked countries are in South America?
questions.why: Only these two have no coast.

questions.q: Which border city is a big shopping hub?
questions.why: It borders Brazil and Argentina.

questions.q: Which dry plain covers western Paraguay?
questions.why: It is hot and sparsely populated.

questions.q: Which pilgrimage town's basilica draws crowds on 8 December?
questions.why: It honours the Virgin of Caacupé.

questions.q: Which Paraguayan football goalkeeper also scored many goals?
questions.why: He took free kicks and penalties.

questions.q: Which harp is Paraguay's national instrument?
questions.why: It has 36 or more strings.

questions.q: Which Paraguayan author wrote 'I, the Supreme'?
questions.why: He won the Cervantes Prize.

questions.q: Which dictator after independence was called 'El Supremo'?
questions.why: He closed the country to the outside world.

questions.q: Which president was impeached and removed in 2012?
questions.why: He had been a Catholic bishop.

questions.q: Which delicate lace is a Paraguayan craft?
questions.why: Its name means 'spider web' in Guaraní.

questions.q: Which two languages are official in Paraguay?
questions.why: Most Paraguayans speak Guaraní.

questions.q: Which religious order built missions among the Guaraní?
questions.why: Their story is told in the film 'The Mission'.

questions.q: Which giant dam on the Paraná does Paraguay share with Brazil?
questions.why: It produces huge amounts of electricity.

questions.q: What is Paraguay's currency?
questions.why: It is named after the Indigenous people.

questions.q: Which cold herbal drink is Paraguay's national drink?
questions.why: It is made with yerba mate and iced water.

questions.q: Which cheesy cornbread is Paraguay's national dish?
questions.why: It is called a soup but is solid.

questions.q: Which cheese bread rings are popular snacks?
questions.why: They are made with cassava flour.

questions.q: Which dam on the Paraná does Paraguay share with Argentina?
questions.why: It flooded a huge area.

questions.q: Which festival of San Juan features walking on hot coals?
questions.why: It is held each June.
